title: Razorpay - India's leading payment gateway and business banking platform
clean_text: Razorpay, founded in 2014, is an Indian fintech offering end-to-end payment processing alongside neobanking (RazorpayX), lending, vendor payouts, and payroll disbursement -- positioning itself as a one-stop business banking shop beyond a pure payment gateway. It serves over 10 million Indian businesses, including Flipkart, Zomato, Swiggy, Ola, CRED, as well as Google, Meta, and Wikipedia, processing more than $150 billion in annual payment volume as of 2025 and holding the largest market share among Indian payment gateways at a valuation above $7.5 billion. Target customers span startups, e-commerce stores, SaaS companies, educational institutions, content creators, and large enterprises.

meta.target: Indian and Asia-based businesses of all sizes, from startups to large enterprises
